context: Mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: いやー/片方/あちら/情けない/火事/外食/つまみ/みかん

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: いやー、翔くん、本気で、絶対、今日は、絶対、よく頑張ったわね
lines.en: Sho, you really worked hard today — I'm genuinely proud of you.
lines.style: Warm, affirming tone. Lean in slightly. Gentle emphasis on his effort. The particular way a mother says she notices.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼくの、本気で、絶対、靴下、絶対、片方、絶対、無くなっちゃった
lines.en: Mom, I actually lost one of my socks today.
lines.style: Deadpan delivery with a small, slightly helpless smile underneath. The matter-of-fact way a kid reports small disasters he knows are silly.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、あちら、絶対、のお部屋、絶対、お掃除しといてね
lines.en: Sho, could you tidy up your room for me, please?
lines.style: Gentle but matter-of-fact. Not a question, but not harsh either. The practiced tone of a parent making a request she expects will be heard.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、宿題、絶対、忘れちゃった、絶対、情けない、絶対、よ
lines.en: Mom, I actually forgot my homework — I feel pretty pathetic about it.
lines.style: Quietly ashamed. Small voice. Eyes down. The genuine self-disappointment of a conscientious child, not seeking comfort but admitting failure.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、近所で、本気で、絶対、火事、絶対、あったらしいわ、注意してね
lines.en: Sho, there was apparently a fire in the neighbourhood — be careful out there, okay?
lines.style: Calm but purposeful. Soft concern underneath. The way a mother shifts into protective mode — not alarming, just making sure he knows to pay attention.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さん、今日は、本気で、絶対、外食、絶対、しようって言ってたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad said today we should go out to eat.
lines.style: Bright, slightly excited. Straightforward delivery with an undertone of 'isn't this good news?'. The small enthusiasm of a child sharing something his father said.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの、本気で、絶対、ビールの、絶対、つまみ、絶対、用意してね
lines.en: Sho, could you get some snacks ready for Dad's beer later?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, practical. Brief and clear. The kind of gentle task-delegation a parent makes knowing their child can handle it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、みかん、絶対、食べてもいい?本気で
lines.en: Mom, can I have a mandarin?
lines.style: Small, hopeful pitch at the end. Polite but eager. The way a child asks permission for something he wants, half-expecting yes, half-expecting no.
